name: White Bean Frittata with Broccoli, Artichokes & Sun-Dried Tomatoes

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
3 crowns broccoli
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place on a plate and set aside.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs and spices in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the egg.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
When the veggies are done, add beans to the skillet and stir to combine.

Reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, sprinkle frittata with reserved basil, then cut into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!
